race.comment: DESIGNS OF EIGHT (6) on top. She's been good in two runs back, both at Ballarat Synthetic. She was unsuited staying at 1400m last time when fourth and now gets the rise in trip to 1600m which should see improvement. CUTE GIRL (4) is the one with upside, a maiden winner two back at Warrnambool before an even effort as favourite at Naracoorte. Can improve again and measure right up. QUEEN AMANJENA (7) looks suited rising in trip off a sound effort at Tatura last week. She draws well and has claims up on speed. SIDE PIECE (1) is going well and comes back a notch, right in this from a good draw where he'll be tracking the pace.
